# Load the dataset
DATA_PATH = 'data/dataset.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(DATA_PATH)

# Display the first few rows and check for missing values
df_info = df.info()
df_head = df.head()
missing_values = df.isnull().sum()

df_info, df_head, missing_values

# Fill missing values with the mean of the respective columns
df['soil_alcalinity'].fillna(df['soil_alcalinity'].mean(), inplace=True)
df['soil_magnesium'].fillna(df['soil_magnesium'].mean(), inplace=True)

# Check for missing values again
missing_values_after = df.isnull().sum()
missing_values_after

import numpy as np

def idw_interpolation(df, x, y, power=2):
    # Calculate distances from the point (x, y) to all known points
    distances = np.sqrt((df['soil_alcalinity'] - x) ** 2 + (df['soil_magnesium'] - y) ** 2)
    
    # Avoid division by zero
    distances[distances == 0] = 1e-10
    
    # Calculate weights
    weights = 1 / distances ** power
    
    # Calculate the weighted average of the known values
    weighted_sum = np.sum(weights * df['phenolic_content'])
    sum_of_weights = np.sum(weights)
    
    # Predicted value
    predicted_value = weighted_sum / sum_of_weights
    return predicted_value

# Define the grid range
alcalinity_range = np.linspace(df['soil_alcalinity'].min(), df['soil_alcalinity'].max(), num=100)
magnesium_range = np.linspace(df['soil_magnesium'].min(), df['soil_magnesium'].max(), num=100)

# Create a mesh grid
grid_x, grid_y = np.meshgrid(alcalinity_range, magnesium_range)

# Initialize an array to hold the predicted values
predicted_values = np.zeros(grid_x.shape)

# Perform IDW interpolation for each point in the grid
for i in range(grid_x.shape[0]):
    for j in range(grid_x.shape[1]):
        predicted_values[i, j] = idw_interpolation(df, grid_x[i, j], grid_y[i, j])

# Calculate the mean and variance of the predicted values
mean_predicted = np.mean(predicted_values)
variance_predicted = np.var(predicted_values)

mean_predicted, variance_predicted

# Calculate the average values for soil_alcalinity and soil_magnesium
average_alcalinity = df['soil_alcalinity'].mean()
average_magnesium = df['soil_magnesium'].mean()

# Predict the phenolic_content at the average values
predicted_at_average = idw_interpolation(df, average_alcalinity, average_magnesium)

average_alcalinity, average_magnesium, predicted_at_average
